about: Conformance vectors for extractor 1's file documents (DESIGN-DETAILS section 11.2; protocol/INDEX-FORMAT.md's Extractor 1). input is the file, as in mail.json. binary marks a file that gives no document. Each document gives title, which is field 4's text: the title, one space and the path; body, field 5; text, keys and row as in mail.json, the row's title being the title alone.
